fields.label: Service
fields.fallback_instruction: Inferred from {TARGET_URL} if not specified. Only include companies that sell this service and run an identifiable conversion path for it (an entry offer, a capture page or form, and a visible next step); a contact-form-only site is still a competitor but is ranked lower and labelled as such.

fields.label: Location
fields.fallback_instruction: Defaults to Australia-wide if not specified, boosting local leaders if provided.
fields.raw_explanation: {LOCATION}, or Australia-wide if not specified, boosting local leaders if provided.

fields.label: Competitor Type
fields.fallback_instruction: If missing or empty, include both types.
fields.raw_explanation: "niche_specialist" = a company specialised in the target's core service/industry. "full_stack_niche" = a full-service company in the same industry prominently offering the target service.

fields.label: Excluded Competitors
fields.fallback_instruction: Auto-populated from this same competitor-analysis stage's own prior output(s) for this client (system-managed dedup), per REVIEW_NEEDED_V2.md item 7 resolution -- the user does not manually retype domains. If no prior run exists for this client/stage, treated as an empty list rather than prompting the user.
fields.raw_explanation: excluded_competitors: [list any domains already sourced in prior runs]
